Period Highlights

Across 50,000 transactions in 2023–2024, the chocolate retail operation generated $1.28M in revenue and $510.5K in profit, maintaining a healthy average profit margin of 40.0%.

Year-over-year revenue moved +1.7% from $632.2K (2023) to $643.1K (2024), while profit shifted +1.6%. Order volume changed by +1.5%, with 24,820 orders in 2023 and 25,180 in 2024.

Key Observations

Best Month: 2024-06 with $56.0K revenue
Product Breadth: 202 products sold across 100 stores to 31,531 unique customers
Discount Impact: 38% of transactions used discounts; discounted orders show -0.0pp lower margins

5. Discount Impact & Profitability Analysis

A critical assessment of how discount levels affect revenue generation, profit margins, and purchasing behavior. 37.5% of all transactions carried a discount.

Revenue & Margin by Discount Level

Margin Erosion Alert: Full-price transactions achieve a 40.0% average margin, while discounted transactions average 40.0% — a gap of -0.0 percentage points. Each discount tier shows progressively lower margins, confirming that discounts directly erode profitability.

Revenue & Profit Split: Discounted vs Full Price

Volume vs Value Trade-off: While discounted transactions represent 38% of orders, they generate a disproportionate share of volume. However, the average order value for discounted sales is $22.78 compared to $27.15 for full-price — indicating that discount-driven customers often purchase at similar levels to full-price customers, but at lower margins.
Recommendation: Consider tightening discount bands above 15%, where margin erosion accelerates without proportional volume uplift. Targeted promotional strategies (loyalty-exclusive or product-specific) may deliver better ROI than broad discount programs.
